## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Record relevant tests and any material limits.

## Ponytail gates

- Review: revision/scope, report and resolved findings.
- Audit: revision/scope, report or revalidated baseline and resolved findings.
- Remaining actionable findings: linked board issues, or none.

## Tracking

Link the affected issues and epics. Close them after acceptance and merge.
